title: Turtles:Willpower
description: This mod adds a small selection of lantern types (DC) to the game. The power rings are made for mid game level use.
body:
Hello, welcome back to my page. I am the QuickTurtleKL. A small time mod dev, using Mcreator for a series of 3 hours challenegs to add superheros (and villains) into the game. The one we have for today is the "Turtles: Willpower" mod, which aims to bring the (DC) Green Lantern into minecraft. 

As always, the mod comes complete with a basic system of the characters powers, and a method to obtain them in survival mode. remember, it's 3 hours to complete an entire mod. so i have to be swift, but as the challenge is a compltete mod, that means it needs to be survival friendly. 

A constusted, the mod has: 

Power ring (green, yellow and red- or, willpower, fear, and rage) 
Lantern uniforms (or costumes if you wish) 
Lantern corps mobs, one for each added core. 
Lantern ring construct tools, sword, picaxe, axe, and a shield. 
Ring laser (needs the ring to be decently charged)
Ring flight, wearing the ring lets you fly. 
Base ring + will, fear, and rage crafting receipes. (use a mod like JEI to see them) 

Issues and "bug" (features, as far as minecraft dev goes) 
using several rings at once may cause problems of multible gear items spawning in the ventory, taking up more then should be. 
using differnt ring types at once IS duable... but it also might cause probelms and WILL take up extra inventory space. 
Flight remains after ring loss for some reason. 

All character rights, powers, and conspects are owned by their respective IP holders. I claim no ownership of the Green Lantern character or powers, they belong to DC films, comics, and games respectivly.  

You are free to make a video on this mod, i would just like you to link it! each download helps!
